purpose: Real 8-bit SDR HEIF/HEIC still-image encoding on Android (MediaCodec image/vnd.android.heic or the documented HEVC fallback). No Bitmap.compress HEIC fake.
notes: The dependency coordinate and version are exact; no dynamic version or range.
The Gradle and lockfile changes are supplied as an exact private Main patch because central build files are Main-owned in the C01-C08 batch.
HeifWriter 1.1.0 hard-codes highBitDepthEnabled=false, so HDR sources are refused by the Floe HEIC boundary rather than silently tone-mapped.
